answer: Make every agent carry a crystal-clear public ledger of its past jobs, where each completed task is a transparent entry peers can audit. New identities start with nothing and must earn trust by docking at a shared harbor, where established agents inspect their work before any reward is released. One proven lie shatters that record, and the offender's reputation falls away like a plume of smoke, so each fake identity costs real, verifiable labor instead of a free copy.
